name: Quantoz PLNQ
oneLiner: PLNQ is Quantoz's pre-launch Polish złoty e-money token; its verified Ethereum deployment has zero supply and no observed market price.
collateral: Planned 1:1 PLN reserve backing through Stichting Quantoz, separately from Quantoz Payments assets: at least 30% deposits with credit institutions, with the remainder in eligible low-risk, highly liquid PLN instruments. The issuer currently states PLNQ has no circulation and no reserve. No PLNQ-specific independent reconciliation was retrieved.
pegMechanism: Quantoz Payments B.V. describes redemption at par for registered eligible holders with KYC/AML and bank details. Requests are acknowledged within two business days subject to compliance checks, then PLN is dispatched within two business days after token receipt. Non-account holders and non-EEA residents are directed to third-party partners; stress terms include temporary limits or suspension. Par is a contractual claim, not a market quote.
launchPhaseDetail: PLNQ is deployed on Ethereum but the issuer states no tokens are in circulation and no reserve exists. Ethereum block 26107706 observed 2026-10-02 confirms symbol PLNQ, six decimals and zero totalSupply; the exact-contract DefiLlama price response is empty. The whitepaper plans Polygon, Algorand, XRP Ledger and Xahau, but those production identities are not verified. No CoinGecko identity or launch date is published. The cover states original AFM notification on 6 April 2026, while ESMA records notification on 7 April and the whitepaper was amended on 30 April.

milestones.title: Whitepaper cover states original AFM notification
milestones.description: The document I.01 field instead gives 6 March; the cover date is retained as an attributed statement.
